# Classifier and nested result carrier bindings

Four independently authored Object method formals retain a classifier input/key,
downstream input/accumulator/value and the complete nested key/value result.
The opaque factory preserves original references and selects its actual result
after an action. No classifier execution follows from these generic relations.

Owned calls to actual SDK grouping observe accessor order, original classifier
inputs, nullable states, captured functions, identity finish and exact partial
failures. Both profiles compile every Java8 unit and preserve original roles,
Signatures, Exceptions and helper identities. All runtime code belongs to this
fixture or the JDK; no application bytecode is executed.
